window.run1: an earlier run (20261018T103547Z) completed Gate A and failed before Gate B on a bash local-scope bug in cell(); its A-B-A artifacts are kept and quoted below where they differ
window.gates: VRAM <= 2600 before cells; 8081 restored healthy after ~24 s

parity.result: 4/4 PASS on build-0146 (default path): iq_parity, native_grouped_parity, iq_multi_parity, qsa_select_wmma_parity

battery_AB_A.note: h2o fails in every arm because the answer is the subscript H2O and the battery regex expects ascii h2o - a battery artifact, identical across arms

quality.battery_answers: identical text in every arm (Paris, 391, Jupiter, 1989, 17, Iron, H2O, 7)

prose_drift.reading: the cross-restart greedy divergence is itself unstable (0.748 then 0.000), so the prose-drift metric is noise-dominated; run 2 shows the deferral does change the prose (as declared), run 1 showed no change for the short sample

quality.engagement: verified: every captured window printed ', deferred' (1/2/3/5/6/8-token windows) and the start-up lines named the 0.1 heavy threshold

verdict.gates: quality A1 PASS (battery), A2 inconclusive/noise-dominated; performance 1K FAIL, 32K FAIL, 128K FAIL
verdict.result: NOT ADOPTED - production stays on build-0145 (exe unchanged, no STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU in the config), verified healthy after the window
verdict.interpretation: the overlap is real at depth (32K ms/round -15.5%/-5.8%) but the output change costs drafter acceptance, so committed tok/s falls at every tier (1K 162 -> 146 accepted); at 1K both the round and the acceptance are worse
verdict.possible_follow_up: a bounded STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU_BELOW sweep (e.g. 0.05/0.02) would trade output divergence for acceptance, but the sign is negative at two tiers and the default 0.1 is upstream's own; not run (declared, not queued as an adoption candidate)
verdict.disposition: the port stays on branch port-2690 / worktree strata-r146 as a dormant, documented experiment; not merged into refresh-0145, not in production
